readme:
# Sarathi-Serve Decode 优先与分块 Prefill

## 1. 问题

先为所有decode保留token预算，再为队首prefill分配不超过上限的块。

一次混合批次的预算分配和多轮回放；以固定token预算与最大块长替代论文的性能模型。

原文: [Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.02310) · Section 4.1–4.2; Algorithm 3, stall-free batching.

## 2. 核心公式

$$
B_{prefill}=B-|D|,\qquad c_i=\min(r_i,C,B_{remaining}),\qquad |D|+\sum_i c_i\le B.
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

- `hybrid_batch(decodes: list[int], prefills: list[int], budget: int, chunk_size: int) -> dict` — Decode IDs, scheduled (prefill_index,token_count) pairs, and remaining tokens.

先扣除所有decode的一个token，再依次处理prefill。若长prompt用完本轮块长但尚未完成，它保留队首位置。不要为新prompt挤掉已有decode，也不要一次执行完整长prompt。

## 4. 本题约定

decodes 是唯一非负请求ID列表；prefills 是按FIFO排列的正剩余token数。budget>=len(decodes)，chunk_size>=1。每个decode本轮运行一次。队首prefill消耗 min(剩余,chunk_size,预算)；未完成则停止接纳后续prefill，本轮每个请求最多一块。返回dict含decodes、prefills(index,count)、remaining(含零完成项)。

## 5. 交互图

固定两个活动decode，prefill长度 13、3、9，预算 8、最大块 4；循环消费队列，验证每轮decode不被暂停及总prefill工作守恒。

T3 使用实际待测函数生成实验，网页参考图使用参考实现。数值来自教学样本，不表示GPU吞吐或完整模型质量。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 延伸

结合所引章节，解释本题保留了哪些维度、状态或调度约束，再扩展实验样本并保持已有契约。更大模型、真实设备与通信代价需要单独测量。

en.readme:
# Sarathi-Serve Decode Priority and Chunked Prefill

## 1. Problem

Reserve tokens for every ongoing decode before assigning bounded chunks to FIFO prefills.

One hybrid-batch budget allocation and repeated replay; fixed token budgets and maximum chunks replace the paper performance model.

Source: [Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.02310) · Section 4.1–4.2; Algorithm 3, stall-free batching.

## 2. Core equations

$$
B_{prefill}=B-|D|,\qquad c_i=\min(r_i,C,B_{remaining}),\qquad |D|+\sum_i c_i\le B.
$$

## 3. From equations to code

- `hybrid_batch(decodes: list[int], prefills: list[int], budget: int, chunk_size: int) -> dict` — Decode IDs, scheduled (prefill_index,token_count) pairs, and remaining tokens.

Subtract one token for every decode first, then process prefills in order. An unfinished long prompt retains the queue head. New prompts cannot displace ongoing decodes or force an unbounded prefill.

## 4. Conventions

decodes is a list of distinct nonnegative IDs; prefills contains positive remaining token counts in FIFO order. budget>=len(decodes), chunk_size>=1. Every decode runs once. Give the head prefill min(remaining,chunk_size,budget_left); if unfinished, stop admitting later prefills. At most one chunk per request per iteration. Return decodes, prefills as (index,count), and remaining with zeros for completed items.

## 5. Experiment view

Keep two decodes active with prefill lengths 13, 3 and 9, budget eight and chunk cap four. Consume the queue over multiple iterations and check uninterrupted decodes and conserved prefill work.

The chart is generated by the actual submitted kernel during T3 and by the reference during export. Values are synthetic teaching measurements, not GPU throughput or full-model quality claims.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Further study

Read the cited section and explain which dimensions or scheduling constraints the kernel preserves. Then extend the experiment beyond the stated fixture while retaining the existing contract. Larger models, real devices, and communication costs require separate measurement.
